fields.note: The "Autofill from resume" uploader's file input (Ashby parses the file on its server and overwrites the form): the adapter excludes the uploader, so it is never a field nor a flagged row.

fields.label: Resume
fields.note: Its label[for] is the visible title (the label proxy); the "Upload File" button beside it is the adapter's upload widget, never pressed.

fields.label: What is your location?
fields.note: Location: a remote search (ApiAutocompleteGeoLocation, typing opens and searches), labelled by the entry's title (labelFor): its placeholder "Start typing..." is no label.

fields.label: Are you happy to work from our office at least 3 days a week?
fields.note: A Yes/No: two typeless buttons with aria-pressed in a div with no role (the adapter's widgetRoots and widgetFor declare it, its members the buttons), labelled by the entry's title, which no for= ties.
The Yes/No's own checkbox (display: none, no label): part of the declared widget, never a field nor a counted hidden control.

fields.label: Do you require visa sponsorship to work in the United States?
fields.note: A Yes/No: two typeless buttons with aria-pressed in a div with no role (the adapter's widgetRoots and widgetFor declare it, its members the buttons), labelled by the entry's title, which no for= ties.
The Yes/No's own checkbox (display: none, no label): part of the declared widget, never a field nor a counted hidden control.

fields.label: How did you hear about us?
I agree
fields.note: A question of one box: a lone checkbox named by its own label[for]; the question's title is its help text (the adapter's descriptionFor), its _required_ mark its required (requiredFor).
